plain_description.what: Rebuilds the tree discovered from embeddings alone, with no declared categories, five times: on a clean question split, with a new random sample (two draws), and with a different construction order. A tree built with declared categories on the clean split serves as a control. For each build it checks which branch points are statistically certified. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: All earlier anchor-free claims came from a single draw (seed 42, on a contaminated split). This test checks whether the 'certified trunk', and the claim that anchors cost certification, belong to the method or to that one seed.
plain_description.information: If the trunk comes back on every draw, the tree's top structure is a property of the method. If it does not, it was luck of the sample. Result: done. The tree exists on all 5 draws and has the same first split. The root and the 'discursive' first-level branch are certified on every draw. The 'quantitative' branch is certified on 3 of 4 draws. Only about 7-8 of the 16 original certified branch points come back on a new sample. On the clean split the anchored control certifies 11 of 60 against 14 of 69, so the earlier claim that 'anchors cost certification' was withdrawn as a headline. This is structural evidence only.
